title: Ring presentation of an affine-base approximation
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let X_i,S_i be inverse systems indexed by a preordered set, with natural morphisms f_i:X_i\to S_i and cones p:Y\to X and s:\operatorname{Spec}A\to S satisfying p_i;f_i=f;s_i. Assume every S_i is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], its global sections are finite type over the integers, the global-section cocone of s is colimiting [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and every f_i is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. There exist a covariant ring diagram B, natural morphisms g:X\to\operatorname{Spec}B and alpha:B\to A, with alpha colimiting, every B_i finite type over the integers, every g_i proper, and p_i;g_i=f;\operatorname{Spec}(alpha_i).

proof.text: Take global sections of the affine base diagram and use the canonical affine-scheme isomorphisms to transport fs. Naturality proves the transition equations. Whisker the given global-section colimit by the double-opposite equivalence and transport its vertex by the global sections of Spec A isomorphism. Convert finite-type ring maps to finite-type algebras and transport properness across isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem affine_approximation_ring_presentation {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] (Xs Ss : Λᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (fs : Xs ⟶ Ss) (p : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj Y ⟶ Xs) (s : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj (Spec (.of A)) ⟶ Ss) (ha : ∀ i, IsAffine (Ss.obj i)) (hft : ∀ i, RingHom.FiniteType (algebraMap ℤ (Scheme.Γ.obj (Opposite.op (Ss.obj i))))) (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit (Scheme.Γ.mapCocone (Cone.mk _ s).op))) (hp : ∀ i, IsProper (fs.app i)) (hw : ∀ i, p.app i ≫ fs.app i = f ≫ s.app i) : ∃ (B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (g : Xs ⟶ B.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec) (α : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (.of A)), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk _ α)) ∧ (∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType ℤ (B.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsProper (g.app i)) ∧ (∀ i, p.app i ≫ g.app i = f ≫ Spec.map (α.app i.unop))
